## Telegram patches for version 12.8.3

### ✅ Patches included (10):
- Telegram Premium — unlocks all premium features
- Remove ads — removes sponsored messages
- Bypass integrity — allows login on patched app
- Bypass content restrictions — allows saving from restricted chats
- Bypass channel restrictions — bypasses sensitive content filters
- Anti-delete messages — prevents deleted messages from disappearing locally
- Anti-disappearing media — disables self-destruct media
- Download speed boost — increases download chunk size and concurrency
- Hide typing indicator — hides your typing status from others
- Disable auto update — disables automatic update prompts

### 📦 App
- **Telegram** `org.telegram.messenger.web` — version `12.8.3`
